name: Fireflies.ai
description: Fireflies.ai lets agents search meeting transcripts and read summaries and action items in the signed-in Fireflies account. Each user signs in to their own Fireflies account through the browser.

prompts.text: List my meetings from this week with a one-line summary of each.
Find what was said about the renewal date in my calls with Acme.
Collect the action items assigned to me in yesterday's meetings.

apps.name: Fireflies.ai
apps.description: Transcript search, summaries, and action items, over Fireflies.ai's MCP server with browser sign-in.
